system.description:
Where many Kindred find the vitae of beasts thin, revolting and barely worth the trouble, you have made the blood of the wild your own, drawing from it a richness others can never taste.

Animal Succulence makes animal vitae particularly nourishing, doubling the number of Blood Traits you may obtain from any single animal you feed upon. The power is passive and requires no expenditure or challenge, and it is not in effect when you feed on humans.
